improvements: 타이포 계층 재정리: 로고 > love LEVEL > 날짜 > 라인업 > 전화번호 > 기타
인물 피부/헤어/고글 반사 디테일 고해상도화, 얼굴이 타이틀과 겹치는 경계 정리
네온 번개 오브젝트에 튜브 네온 질감(유리관 + 내부 발광 + 바닥 반사) 추가
하단 정보 블록을 반투명 다크 패널 위에 배치해 가독성 확보
스폰서 로고 동일 높이/동일 간격 흰색 단색 처리
안전 여백(상하 4%, 좌우 5%) 확보로 스토리 UI 가림 방지
컬러 그레이딩: 하이라이트 시안, 섀도 딥퍼플, 미드톤 마젠타 유지하되 채도 클리핑 방지

gpt_image_2.usage: 원본 이미지를 reference로 첨부 → 아래 prompt 입력 → 텍스트 오류가 있으면 'edit' 모드로 해당 영역만 재요청
gpt_image_2.prompt: Ultra-premium nightclub event poster, vertical 9:16, cyberpunk neon x Y2K chrome style, commercial agency quality. Background: deep violet to magenta-crimson gradient with diagonal neon light streaks radiating from center, soft purple particle haze, subtle film grain. TOP: small white thin sans-serif tagline "Vive Una nueva experiencia!", below it a wide italic chrome logo "LEVEL" with spaced small caps "BARCELONA". CENTER TITLE: huge glossy 3D extruded cyan metallic lettering "love LEVEL" with a pink glossy 3D heart on the left, magenta rim light, inner highlights, bevel, soft glow. LEFT: rounded-rectangle white outline date badge with huge cyan "23", white bold "SAB", small "SEPT.", cyan "COVER 15€" beneath. HERO: a stylish futuristic woman, messy platinum blonde short hair, cyan LED-frame visor goggles with detailed reflections, black techwear jacket with acid-yellow shoulder stripes and high collar, cool neutral expression, 3/4 view, cyan rim light plus pink fill, realistic skin texture, sharp detail. Two large symmetrical glass-tube neon lightning-bolt sculptures in cyan and pink on left and right edges with reflections and bloom. BOTTOM LINEUP: "DJ TINCHO ||| DJ EMBOOW ||| DJ A-KIID" bold condensed type, cyan and white. INFO BLOCK on a translucent dark panel: "SÍGUENOS: @LEVELBARCELONA_OFICIAL @BYAXELOFFICIAL", "INFO SOLO POR WHATSAPP", large bold white "651 99 60 88", "GRAN VÍA 770 - 772 BARCELONA EX SALA \"SAN PUES\"", "WWW.LEVELBARCELONA.COM", plus a small white t-shirt icon with a prohibition sign labeled "CUIDA TU IMAGEN". Bottom row: six white monochrome sponsor logos evenly spaced, equal height, matching the reference: Brugal, Johnnie Walker, Patrón Tequila, Dom Pérignon, Grey Goose Vodka, Belvedere Vodka. Render all text exactly as written, correct spelling and accents, razor-sharp edges, strong hierarchy, balanced composition, safe margins 5%. Cinematic color grading: cyan highlights, magenta midtones, deep violet shadows. 8k detail, no extra text, no watermark, no distorted letters, no extra fingers.
gpt_image_2.negative_prompt: misspelled text, blurry letters, duplicated words, warped logos, plastic skin, extra limbs, cropped title, low contrast small text, oversaturated clipping, watermark
